integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the definition of abundancy and exact rational inequalities. The focal friendly-number paper was read across its full seven-page text, Ziller's open full text and the current problem record were inspected, and targeted literature/database searches were compared at the statement and implication level.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes both coprime inputs satisfy \(\Omega\le4\). It does not address pairs with one or both entries of larger total prime-factor multiplicity. The finite checker is corroborative only; the universal theorem is established by the denominator argument and exact rational exponent-partition bounds.
title: Coprime abundancy distinctness through four prime factors
